messages.subject: about to iteminfo?
parts:
Hi All,

First of all, I apologize for keeping you busy with this issue. There is a problem with my syntax and I cannot solve it. When I examined the existing documents, I saw that the item information functions are related to exploratory models. I could not come across a study on confirmatory ones. I need to get the item information functions related to the model I built below. I would be very happy if you can help me.

MBTI4 <- mirt.model('
    EI = 1-24
    SN = 25-43
    TF = 44-66
    JP = 67-91
    COV = JP*EI, JP*TF, JP*SN, EI*TF, EI*SN, TF*SN')
Sonuc4 <- mirt(data=mbti_4, model=MBTI4,
               method= "SEM", itemtype = 'nominal',
               SE=TRUE, verbose=FALSE,
               accelerate = "Ramsay")
